records: Both sides must have the exact same record IDs and exact per-record source hashes; no partial intersection.
labels: Both sides must have the same explicit stable label IDs; probability vectors are permuted by identity.
thresholds: Every label requires explicit inclusive >= thresholds in [0,1] for each model; no optimizer or fallback.
provenance: Each model: modelId, checkpointSha256, preprocessingSha256, datasetManifestSha256. Threshold policy: sourceCommit, sourceTree, artifactSha256. Hashes are caller-declared; byte verification is a separate upstream gate.
